c74object.name: sc_code
c74object.description: An in-patch sclang editor with the evaluation keys of the SuperCollider IDE, syntax highlighting, auto-indent, bracket matching, undo, snippets and a call-signature bar. Each evaluation leaves its outlet as one eval message (one symbol, multi-line, no temporary file) and panic leaves the keys that stop the engine; connect the outlet to the message inlet of sc3~. The text is saved with the patch.

inlet.description: Receives theme, themes, snippets, index, scrollspeed and attribute messages.

outlet.digest: eval code or panic, to sc3~
outlet.description: Each evaluation sends eval followed by the code as one symbol, so line breaks, commas and quotes reach sclang intact. The panic keys send panic. The index message sends the eval that writes the class library index.

method.name: (keyboard)
method.description:
Click the box to give it the focus, then:
Shift+Return: evaluate the current line.
Cmd+Return: evaluate the selection, else the enclosing ( ... ) region, else the line. Only round brackets in column 0 form a region, as in the SuperCollider IDE.
Cmd+Shift+Return: evaluate the whole text.
Ctrl+. or Cmd+/: send panic. Cmd+. is the Max scheduler stop and cannot be used.
Cmd+Z, Cmd+Shift+Z: undo, redo. Cmd+X, Cmd+C, Cmd+V, Cmd+A: cut, copy, paste, select all.
Tab: insert the suggestion shown in the bar; at the start of an argument, write its keyword (freq: ); otherwise indent. Shift+Tab: next suggestion, or outdent. Esc: close the suggestions.
Return inserts a line break with the indentation of the SuperCollider IDE.

method.name: (mouse)
method.description: Click and drag to select; the wheel or trackpad scrolls (see scrollspeed). Right-click opens a menu: Undo, Redo, Cut, Copy, Paste, Delete, Select All, Save to .scd and Load from .scd. Saving sets file to the chosen path.

method.name: (drag)
method.digest: Drop files to insert their paths
method.description: Dropping files from the Finder inserts their absolute paths at the caret as SuperCollider strings, separated by spaces, ready for Buffer.read or SoundFile.openRead.

method.name: themes
method.description: Posts the available themes and the one in use to the Max console.

method.name: snippets
method.description: Same as snippets. Words split by a message box are joined back with spaces, and one pair of quotes is removed, so snippets '~/My Folder/snips.txt' works. Without a path, the snippets are dropped.

method.name: index
method.digest: Write the class library index through sc3~
method.description: Sends an eval that makes sclang write every class, method and argument name to the index file (see indexfile). The outlet must be connected to a running sc3~. With a path, writes there once instead. Run it again after installing Quarks or changing Extensions.

attribute.name: theme
attribute.description: Sets every color in one step: onedark, catppuccin, dracula, nord, gruvbox, monokai or solarized. Aliases are accepted (mocha, solarizeddark, ...). A color set by hand wins over the theme: sc_code @theme nord @bgcolor 1 0 0 1 is nord with a red background.

attribute.name: fontsize
attribute.digest: Font size in points (6 to 48, default 12)

attribute.name: tabwidth
attribute.digest: Spaces per indentation level (1 to 16, default 4)
attribute.description: Used by auto-indent and by Tab and Shift+Tab.

attribute.name: linenumbers
attribute.description: Shows the line number gutter on the left.

attribute.name: readonly
attribute.description: With 1, the text cannot be changed, but it can still be selected, copied and evaluated.

attribute.name: autoclose
attribute.description: Typing (, [, { or a quote inserts its closing pair.

attribute.name: wrap
attribute.description: Wraps lines at the box width for display. The text itself is unchanged.

attribute.name: matchbrackets
attribute.digest: Highlight the bracket pair at the caret (default 1)
attribute.description: Highlights the matching bracket with matchcolor.

attribute.name: titlebar
attribute.description: A strip at the top labelled sclang.

attribute.name: callaid
attribute.digest: Show the call-signature and completion bar (default 1)
attribute.description: Reserves one line at the bottom of the box. With the caret inside a call it shows the signature, the current argument in barhighlight and its position (2/4); on a name such as Duty.kr it shows the signature alone. From three typed letters it shows the best completion: Tab inserts it. The data comes from the index file (see index); without it the bar stays empty. Typing never changes the text by itself.

attribute.name: indexfile
attribute.digest: Path of the class library index
attribute.description: Default: sc_code-index.txt next to sc_code.mxo, one file shared by every sc_code. The editor only reads it, and reloads it when it changes, so the bar works without a running engine.

attribute.name: snippets
attribute.description: A text file of blocks, each starting with a line ### key (key: letters, digits, underscore), followed by its code verbatim. Type snip.key and press Cmd+Return: the text is replaced by the block and nothing is evaluated. Relative, absolute and ~ paths work; the file is reread when it changes. Saved with the patch.

attribute.name: file
attribute.description: The file used by autoload, autowrite and the context menu's save item.

attribute.name: autoload
attribute.digest: Load file when it is set (default 1)
attribute.description: Replaces the text with the contents of file whenever file is set.

attribute.name: autowrite
attribute.description: Writes the text to file 400 ms after the last edit.

attribute.name: blink
attribute.description: Flashes the evaluated range with blinkcolor for blinkduration.

attribute.name: blinkduration
attribute.digest: Flash length in ms (50 to 5000, default 500)

attribute.name: scrollspeed
attribute.digest: Wheel and trackpad scroll factor (0.05 to 50, default 3)
attribute.description: Multiplies the scroll distance of the wheel or trackpad.

attribute.name: barhighlight
attribute.digest: Current argument in the call bar

c74object.discussion: sc_code never talks to the engine: it only sends messages from its outlet. Expanding a snip.key sends nothing. Evaluation never writes a file. The text, caret and scroll position are saved with the patch.
